summary: 78-year-old man missing ~7 months (last seen 2017-11-14 after his vehicle got stuck in snow near FSR 380 at Prospect Mountain) searched by two SARDOC dog teams; thick pine/deadfall searched, only a vest of unknown ownership and inconclusive interest in a woodshed — no clues found
notes: Search date 2018-06-10 (Sunday-verified). Subject from El Paso County. Per the SARDOC Jan-Jul-2018 mid-year summary, remains believed likely scattered by animals after ~7 months; not located (id-502 no-clues convention). Row mined from the 0718SARDOCPublicSearchSummaries.pdf mid-year file surfaced by run 650; the full-year 2018 file (2018SARDOCPublicSearchSummaries123118.pdf) is already in the DB.
